cost_totals.scope: Two actual allocations counted once. Nested stage timers are descriptive and not additional cost. The earlier build gate, 1GiB lifecycles, post-warmup profile, queue delay and local review are excluded from these two-allocation totals. Coupled CPU cost does not add a separate CPU-only allocation.

scope: Bounded own-four correctness and recovery for ordinary bnb/full with a 3GiB cache on the final native wheel. Each case compares only its own same-cache interruption branches and reloads.
